message: a backend parameter default must be a bare backend name
why: A parameter default becomes `params[].v`, a constant folded at compile time — so `backend = 1 + 1` has no value to record, because there is no evaluator at run time. And which backend is used is read **only** from a bare identifier: `backend = "homonoia"` folds into {"k":"string","v":"homonoia"} and still leaves the backend name empty, so the next error the user sees is about something else entirely. A dotted name is worse — it folds to its **last** segment and silently selects a different backend.
fix: write the backend bare and unquoted: `backend = homonoia`
or omit the parameter entirely: a workflow without it simply has no default backend
